title: Recoup
wikitext:
'''Recoup''' is a [[keyword]] mechanic that [[recovery|recovers]] an amount of [[life]], [[mana]], or [[energy shield]] over time, based on the [[damage taken]] from a [[hit]]. 

__TOC__

==Mechanics== 
The amount recoup recovers is based on a percentage of hit damage taken, calculated after [[receiving damage|mitigation]] such as [[resistance]], though before mechanics that change how damage is applied (e.g. [[Ward]], {{il|Steelskin}}, {{il|Petrified Blood}}, {{il|The Jinxed Juju}}, {{il|Dissolution of the Flesh}}).<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/mcqir3/314_league_info_megathread/gtwbzro/?context=1</ref> For example, if {{psl|Mind Over Matter}} splits 100 damage to 60 damage to life and 40 damage to mana, recoup will still be based on 100 damage. Instances of recoup stack; each instance is independent.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3130696</ref>

Recouping normally occurs over 4 seconds, meaning a value of {{c|mod|40% of Damage taken Recouped as Life}} recovers 10% of the damage taken per second. This duration may be modified through stats such as the {{c|mod|Life Recoup Effects instead occur over 3 seconds}} [[Recovery Mastery]] passive, granting the same total recovery over an altered duration. Like other over-time recovery effects, modifiers to the player's overall {{c|mod|recovery rate}} will scale recoup's recovery without lowering its duration. 

Unlike [[leech]] or [[flask]]s, recoup instances are not removed when the relevant resource is filled, and their duration or rate are unaffected by effect expiration modifiers such as {{il|Temporal Chains}}. Recoup instances are not considered buffs, debuffs, or skill effects.

===Jewels===
[[Abyss Jewel]]s can have 2-3% of damage taken recouped as mana as a prefix. Harvest (until version 3.19 which removes the craft) can give jewels 1% implicit recouped mana. During [[heist league]] the heist can drop jewel with the enchantment implicit that the same as the harvest implicit . This gives a theoretical maximum of 5% per Abyss jewel (and 2% per classic jewel, timeless jewel and cluster jewel by stacking the two implicits) in permanent leagues. Multiple jewels can stack these modifiers additively.

{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mods.stat_text LIKE "%Recoup%" AND domain IN ( "10", "13") AND generation_type !=3
|domain=1
|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type=1
|group=1
}}

;legacy mod:
{{Modifier table
|q_where=mods.id = "JewelImplicitDamageTakenGainedAsMana"
|stat_text=1
|level=1
}}

===Elevated===
The following modifiers can only be obtained by using a {{il|Maven's Orb}} on an influenced [[Body Armour]] which have at least two influenced mods, including  an existing T1 [[damage taken as]] mod. Note that the orb remove one random influenced mod in the process and upgrade another influence mod. Moreover, all the damage taken as explicit mods are in the same mod group thus using the orb on legacy item that have two damage taken as mods, may remove the mod but not adding the new elevated mod.
